associations.rationale: This type family constructs the candidate modules V_i, but its displayed formal type alone does not state their action, simplicity, dimension, classification, or pairwise nonisomorphism.
The equality directly states that an upper-triangular matrix acts on V_i by its i-th diagonal entry.
The existential equivalence directly states that every simple module is isomorphic to one of the indexed modules V_i.
The finrank equality directly states that each indexed module V_i is one-dimensional.
The instance-valued statement directly establishes that every indexed diagonal-character module V_i is simple.
For distinct indices, the negated nonempty linear equivalence directly states that V_i and V_j are nonisomorphic.
